name: @almajeed/erp
description: Al-Majeed ERP — clients, projects, employees, finance, documents, tasks, analytics and an AI agent in one system.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @almajeed/shared && npm run build -w @almajeed/db
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @almajeed/api && npm run build -w @almajeed/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.demo: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:demo:api" "npm:demo:web"
